claim_vs_prior_implication.evidence: Prior Table 2 entries (AF 2007 Table 2; FG 2010 Table 2) imply the Nichols algebra B(V0) is the 4-dim exterior algebra — consistent with but strictly weaker than the headline. The headline adds the lifting rigidity: every finite-dim H with gr H = A0 equals A0 (all three quadratic relation values vanish; cocycle ledger trivial). FG Corollary 3.4 proves bosonization-only rigidity only for singleton families with k != n, not for the singleton central-class 2-dim-irrep module M_l (the V0 case), whose liftings in the m>=12 regime belong to the deformed families; AF 2007 states no lifting theorem at all.
